question: The Jewish festival of lights is called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hanukkah.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hanukkah **is a** Jewish festival** that lasts for **eight days and nights.**
 
• It commemorates the **rededication of the Second Temple** in **Jerusalem** after it was reclaimed from the Seleucid Empire in the 2nd century BCE.
 
• The festival is also known as the** Festival of Lights** because of the tradition of lighting a special candelabrum called a** menorah.**
 
• Other customs associated with Hanukkah include** playing with dreidels** (spinning tops) and eating foods fried in oil, such as** latkes** (potato pancakes) and **sufganiyot** (jelly donuts).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nauroj** is a **Persian New Year **celebration.

 
 
• It takes place on the** spring equinox.**
 
 
 
• **Anthurium** is a type of** tropical flower** often used in floral arrangements.
 
• **Hornbill** is a type of** bird** found in Africa and Asia.
